_note: The frontmatter contract of your brain. One file owns the closed lists, and check_frontmatter.py, brain_health.py and save-to-obsidian all read it. Edit it freely: add a type, a status or a project, and every tool follows. Keys are compared in lowercase.
tags_form: lowercase, no accents, no spaces (use a hyphen), no leading #

type_help.session: A session log in 06 Session Logs
type_help.decision: A decision with its reasons, in 02 Strategy/Decision Log
type_help.lesson: Something learned the hard way, in 01 .../Lessons Learned
type_help.idea: An idea before it becomes a project, in 03 Ideas & Notes
type_help.learning: Notes from a book, course or article, in 04 Learning
type_help.reference: A saved source (web clip, quote, link)
type_help.person: A person you work or live with
type_help.process: How something is done, step by step
type_help.architecture: How your system or tools fit together, in 05 AI System
type_help.integration: A tool connection or a skill hub, in 05 AI System
type_help.moc: A Map of Content: a hub that links a theme together, in 09 MOCs
type_help.door: The front door of a project: current state in one screen, in 09 MOCs
type_help.checkpoint: The rolling state of a long working session, in 06 Session Logs
type_help.note: Anything that fits nowhere else yet
